schemes.name: e-Shram
schemes.description: National database for unorganized workers. Provides accidental insurance and access to welfare schemes.
schemes.benefit: Accidental insurance cover of ₹2 lakh. Gateway to other schemes.

conditions: Must be an unorganized/informal worker
Must have Aadhaar card

enrollment_steps: Visit eshram.gov.in or your nearest CSC center
Keep Aadhaar card and bank passbook ready
Fill in personal details and work type
Receive e-Shram card with UAN number

schemes.name: PMJAY (Ayushman Bharat)
schemes.description: World's largest health insurance scheme providing ₹5 lakh per year per family for secondary and tertiary hospitalization.
schemes.benefit: Free health insurance cover of ₹5 lakh per year for your family.

conditions: Family income below poverty line
Listed in SECC 2011 data or eligible categories

enrollment_steps: Visit any empaneled hospital or Ayushman Mitra
Carry Aadhaar card and ration card
Check eligibility on mera.pmjay.gov.in
If eligible, get your Ayushman card printed free
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

schemes.name: PM-SYM (Shram Yogi Maan-dhan)
schemes.description: Pension scheme for informal workers. Guarantees ₹3,000/month pension after age 60.

conditions: Unorganized sector worker
Monthly income below ₹15,000
Not member of EPFO/ESIC/NPS

enrollment_steps: Visit nearest CSC center with Aadhaar and bank details
Monthly contribution: ₹55 (age 18) to ₹200 (age 40)
Government matches your contribution equally
Receive pension from age 60

schemes.name: BOCW (Building & Other Construction Workers)
schemes.description: Welfare fund for construction workers providing education, pension, medical, and housing support.
schemes.benefit: Education support ₹25,000-₹1 lakh for children, medical aid ₹1 lakh, pension ₹3,000/month.

conditions: Must have worked 90+ days in construction in past year
Must register with State BOCW Board

enrollment_steps: Visit State Labour Department or BOCW Board office
Carry Aadhaar, work certificate from contractor, passport photo
Pay registration fee (₹25-50 depending on state)
Receive BOCW registration card valid for 3 years

schemes.name: PM-SVANidhi (Street Vendor Loans)
schemes.description: Micro-credit facility for street vendors. Working capital loan up to ₹50,000.

conditions: Must be a street vendor
Must have vending certificate or Letter of Recommendation from ULB

enrollment_steps: Visit pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or nearest bank
Carry Aadhaar, vendor ID/certificate, bank details
Apply for ₹10,000 first tranche loan
Repay timely to qualify for ₹20,000 second tranche
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

schemes.name: MGNREGA
schemes.description: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment per year to rural households.
schemes.benefit: 100 days guaranteed work at ₹267-374/day (varies by state). Total ₹26,700-37,400/year.

conditions: Must be a rural household member
Must have job card or apply for one

enrollment_steps: Visit Gram Panchayat office with passport photo and ID
Apply for MGNREGA Job Card (free)
Once issued, demand work in writing at Gram Panchayat
Work must be provided within 15 days of demand

schemes.name: ESIC (Employees State Insurance)
schemes.description: Medical insurance and cash benefits for workers in organized sector establishments.
schemes.benefit: Full medical care for worker and family. Sickness benefit at 70% of wages. Maternity benefit.

conditions: Working in a factory/establishment with 10+ workers
Monthly wages up to ₹21,000

enrollment_steps: Your employer must register the establishment
Employer deducts 0.75% of wages as your contribution
Get your ESIC card / Pehchan card from dispensary
Visit any ESIC hospital or dispensary for free treatment

schemes.name: INSS (Instituto Nacional do Seguro Social)
schemes.description: Brazilian social security for informal workers. Provides retirement pension, sickness benefits, and maternity pay.
schemes.benefit: Retirement pension, sickness allowance, maternity salary. Minimum R$1,412/month pension.

conditions: Must register as Individual Contributor (Contribuinte Individual)
Monthly contribution: 11% of minimum wage (MEI) or 20% of income

enrollment_steps: Access meu.inss.gov.br or call 135
Register with CPF number
Choose contribution plan: MEI (5%), simplified (11%), or full (20%)
Generate monthly payment slip (GPS) and pay at any bank

schemes.name: Bolsa Família
schemes.description: Family income transfer program for families in poverty and extreme poverty.
schemes.benefit: R$600/month per family + R$150 per child (0-6 years). Total varies by family size.

conditions: Family per-capita income up to R$218/month
Registered in CadÚnico (Single Registry)

enrollment_steps: Visit your nearest CRAS (Social Assistance Center)
Register in CadÚnico with CPF, ID, proof of address
Family income assessment will be conducted
If approved, receive Bolsa Família card from Caixa Econômica

schemes.name: Seguro Desemprego
schemes.description: Unemployment insurance for formally employed workers who were dismissed without cause.
schemes.benefit: 3-5 monthly payments based on last salary. Range: R$1,412 to R$2,313 per month.

conditions: Dismissed without just cause
Worked minimum 12 months in last 18 (1st request)
Not receiving other INSS benefit

enrollment_steps: Apply within 7-120 days of dismissal
Access gov.br portal or visit SINE office
Carry CTPS (work card), dismissal term, CPF, ID
Payments deposited to Caixa Econômica account

schemes.name: UIF (Unemployment Insurance Fund)
schemes.description: South African unemployment insurance providing benefits for unemployment, illness, maternity, and adoption.
schemes.benefit: Up to 238 days of unemployment benefits. 38-58% of daily earnings.

conditions: Must have been employed and contributing to UIF
Employer must have registered with UIF
Must have worked 24+ months in last 4 years

enrollment_steps: Your employer deducts 1% of salary and contributes another 1%
When unemployed, visit nearest Labour Centre
Bring ID, UIF registration, last payslip, bank details
Complete UI-2.1 and UI-2.8 application forms

schemes.name: SASSA SRD Grant (R370)
schemes.description: Social Relief of Distress grant for unemployed South Africans aged 18-60.

conditions: South African citizen/permanent resident/refugee
Unemployed with no income
Not receiving other social grant or UIF

enrollment_steps: Apply online at srd.sassa.gov.za
Enter SA ID number and cellphone number
Verify via OTP and submit banking details
Status checked monthly; re-application may be required

schemes.name: COIDA (Compensation for Occupational Injuries)
schemes.description: Compensation for workers injured or diseased during employment.
schemes.benefit: Medical treatment costs, temporary disability payments (75% of earnings), permanent disability lump sum.

conditions: Must have been injured during employment
Employer must be registered with Compensation Fund
Claim within 12 months of accident

enrollment_steps: Report injury to employer immediately
Employer must submit WCL.2 form to Compensation Commissioner
Visit any public hospital — treatment is free under COIDA
Follow up on claim at nearest Labour Centre

schemes.name: Social Insurance Fund (FSS)
schemes.description: Russian social insurance providing sickness benefits, maternity pay, and workplace injury compensation.
schemes.benefit: Sick leave at 60-100% of salary. Maternity benefit for 140 days. Workplace injury compensation.

conditions: Officially employed or self-employed with voluntary contributions
Employer makes social insurance contributions

enrollment_steps: Enrolled automatically if officially employed
Self-employed can register voluntarily at local FSS branch
For sickness: obtain sick leave certificate from doctor
Submit documents to employer or directly to FSS
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Labour and Social Protection

schemes.name: Federal Employment Support
schemes.description: Russian federal employment assistance including job search help, retraining, and unemployment benefits.
schemes.benefit: Unemployment benefit: ₽4,000-12,792/month. Free retraining programs. Job placement assistance.

conditions: Must register at Employment Centre (Центр занятости)
Must be actively seeking work

enrollment_steps: Visit nearest Employment Centre with passport and work book
Register as job seeker
After 11 days, receive official unemployed status
Start receiving unemployment benefits and access retraining

schemes.name: Dibao (最低生活保障)
schemes.description: China's Minimum Livelihood Guarantee providing monthly cash assistance to families below the poverty line.
schemes.benefit: Monthly supplement to bring income up to local minimum standard. ¥500-1,200/month depending on city.

conditions: Per-capita income below local Dibao standard
Must hold local hukou (household registration)
No assets exceeding local limits

enrollment_steps: Apply at community/village committee (社区/村委会)
Provide ID, hukou, income proof, bank details
Community conducts household survey and public review
If approved, receive monthly Dibao payment to bank account

schemes.name: NRSI (New Rural Social Insurance / 新农保)
schemes.description: Social pension insurance for rural residents in China.
schemes.benefit: Basic pension: ¥103+/month (government subsidy) + personal account accumulation. Total varies by contribution level.

conditions: Rural hukou holder aged 16-60
Not enrolled in urban employee pension
Contribute annually for 15+ years to receive pension at 60

enrollment_steps: Apply at village/township social insurance office
Choose annual contribution level (¥100-2,000/year)
Government provides subsidy of ¥30-60 per year
Receive basic pension + personal account pension at age 60
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security (人力资源和社会保障部)
